finding.comment: The opening claim that all responses come from the cache directly contradicts the Probes section; a reader cannot tell which behavior is real.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/caching.md
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Response caching
+
+All API responses are served from the cache. The origin is contacted
+only to repopulate entries after expiry.
+
+## Probes
+
+/health and /metrics bypass the cache and always hit origin services,
+so probes reflect live state.
